Models.Catalog.parakeet_tdt_0.6b_v3_onnx: Most accurate model on our test set, now with live streaming: words show within a fraction of a second and settle about a second later. 25 European languages, compact 4-bit download.
The recommended Parakeet with a repacked encoder: a third smaller download and about 190 MB less memory, with the same accuracy on our test set. Good for phones and machines with little RAM.
Full-precision Parakeet with live streaming. Slightly more accurate than INT4, at the cost of a much larger download and more memory.
Lightest CPU load of the Parakeet variants, with lower accuracy on our test set.
Models.Catalog.nemotron_3.5_asr_streamin: More audio context for better accuracy and the lowest CPU load. Text appears with a slight lag.
The 1.12s Nemotron with a repacked encoder: a 37% smaller download, about a quarter faster and 250 MB less memory, with the same accuracy on our test set.
Full precision and maximum accuracy, at the cost of a larger download and more memory.
Most responsive — words appear almost instantly as you speak. Compact 4-bit size.
The 0.56s Nemotron with a repacked encoder: a third smaller download, about 30% faster and 200 MB less memory, with the same accuracy on our test set.
Full precision with the shortest delay. Good when you want responsiveness without giving up accuracy.
Models.Catalog.qwen3_asr_1.7b_onnx.Descr: High-quality multilingual recognition using Qwen3's decoder with 2-second encoder blocks and a fixed 16-second feature context. Text appears sooner, with a higher CPU load than Nemotron.

Models.Llm.gemma_4_e2b.Tagline: Fast and light. Good for live translation and short chats.
Models.Llm.gemma_4_e2b.Description: The default model: 2.6 GB on disk, about 3 GB of memory while loaded. Runs on phones and laptops, translates live without lag and answers simple questions about a recording.
Models.Llm.gemma_4_e4b.Tagline: Better answers and translation, twice the reading window. Wants the GPU.
Models.Llm.gemma_4_e4b.Description: Noticeably more accurate chat answers and summaries of long recordings, and a longer context window (8192 tokens). 3.7 GB on disk. Use the GPU backend: on the CPU it generates about 4 words per second and needs half a minute to read a long question. Desktop only.
Models.Llm.gemma_4_12b.Tagline: Experimental. Highest quality, very slow on the CPU. Desktop only.
Models.Llm.gemma_4_12b.Description: The largest model offered: 6.9 GB on disk, about 9 GB of memory on the CPU (about 8 GB of video memory on the GPU). On the CPU it is accurate but needs about two minutes to read a 2000-token question. On the GPU the current LiteRT-LM runtime returns garbage for prompts longer than about 500 tokens, so chat over a recording does not work there yet.
Models.Translation.HintTitle: Live translation runs on the device
Models.Translation.HintText: Gemma 4 E2B (LiteRT-LM) translates the transcript sentence by sentence; nothing is sent to a server.
Models.Translation.Footnote: Turn on live translation from the menu on the main screen. The model is used for every target language.

Models.Speakers.Intro: Tells who spoke when, on this device. Run it from a recording (Detect speakers) or after each recording stops.
Models.Speakers.Privacy: Speaker labels are computed on this device from the saved audio. No voice prints are stored: speakers are numbered inside one recording.
Models.Speakers.Facts: ONNX · about 100M parameters · up to 8 speakers · runs on this device

Models.Speakers.diarization_int8.Descrip: 8-bit weights: about 105 MB, two to three times faster than full precision with the same accuracy (within half a point of speaker error). Runs on phones and laptops.
Models.Speakers.diarization_fp32.Descrip: Full-precision weights: about 399 MB. The reference the INT8 model is measured against; pick it only when you want the exact original numbers. Desktop only.

Models.Storage.Explanation: All models live in one folder, one sub-folder per kind. Copy a model folder into the matching sub-folder and it shows up.
Models.Storage.ChangeRootNote: Changing the folder: models already downloaded can move there when the app restarts (same drive), or stay where they are.
